scopePt: Acervo parcial da pesquisa recente de embreagem 02S, acionamento hidraulico e estrutura dianteira. Nao cobre o carro inteiro nem os 27 componentes.

policy.backupPt: As imagens estao ignoradas pelo Git. Backup local deve incluir esta pasta; um clone do repositorio tera o indice, nao as imagens.
policy.usePt: Abrir a referencia antes de modelar; conferir silhueta, montagem e orientacao. Usar medidas documentadas para escala. Nao extrair cotas de fabrica de perspectiva, pixels ou desenho sem escala. Registrar medidas estimadas separadamente.
policy.downloadPt: Usar sourceImageUrl para recuperar arquivos ausentes, verificar o formato real e o SHA256. Conteudo diferente exige revisao; nao substituir silenciosamente. Alguns enderecos .png retornam WebP.

catalogVehicleQuery.descriptionPt: VOLKSWAGEN GOLF V (1K1) 2.0 FSI, 110 kW, 1984 ccm, 01/2004-11/2008, Frontantrieb, motores BLR/BLX/BVX/AXW/BVZ/BVY/BLY
catalogVehicleQuery.limitsPt: Consulta por veiculo em catalogo de reposicao, nao por VIN nem por codigo de cambio. Cobre sete codigos de motor de uma vez e nao distingue variantes de embreagem instaladas de fabrica.

images.usePt: Ordem e ligacoes do cilindro externo, alavanca, pivo, mola, guia e rolamento separado.
images.limitsPt: Vista explodida sem cotas; nao confirma codigo de peca, dimensoes ou posicao instalada.

images.usePt: Orientacao da alavanca montada e acesso ao mecanismo de retencao.
images.limitsPt: Sem cotas; verificar a fixacao da mola no procedimento antes de modelar.

images.usePt: Abertura da alavanca e encaixe dos grampos do rolamento.
images.limitsPt: Os grampos do rolamento nao sao a mola de retencao item 5. Sem dimensoes de fabrica.

images.usePt: Sequencia volante, disco e plato da variante Sachs do manual 02S.
images.limitsPt: Manual exige selecao via catalogo de pecas; nao prova aplicacao AXW nem cotas axiais.

images.usePt: Conferir faces, cubo, revestimento e silhueta do disco candidato.
images.limitsPt: Aplicacao no veiculo pendente. Foto de catalogo nao e desenho cotado; perfil do cubo nao define sozinho o eixo macho. Nao adotar medidas de espessura pela foto.

images.usePt: Segunda vista para comparar o relevo do cubo e as faces do mesmo disco candidato.
images.limitsPt: Mesmas restricoes da primeira vista: aplicacao, espessuras e distancias axiais ainda pendentes.

images.usePt: Identificar consoles, suportes, bieletas e as duas buchas do apoio pendular.
images.limitsPt: Ha variantes de bandeja e buchas; nao combinar alternativas. Sem coordenadas de fixacao.

images.usePt: Distinguir consoles 1/8, agregado 4/5 e suportes 9/18.
images.limitsPt: Numeracao propria desta prancha; nao sao medidas nem coordenadas XYZ. T10096 usa quatro das seis posicoes.

images.usePt: Localizacao do suporte da bandeja com ferramenta T10096.
images.limitsPt: Nao fornece cotas do suporte nem o datum do veiculo.

images.usePt: Localizacao do console com ferramenta T10096.
images.limitsPt: Nao fornece dimensoes do console nem coordenadas dos seis apoios.

images.usePt: Identificar o volante item 10 no contexto do virabrequim; consultar a tabela de aplicacao, nao apenas a imagem.
images.limitsPt: Prancha de mercado sul-africano; tabela associa AXW mas nao explicita 02S/FWD. Nao e consulta VW por VIN nem desenho dimensional.

images.usePt: Visao geral do acionamento dividida em I pedaleira, II hidraulica LHD e III hidraulica RHD; define o escopo dos tres conjuntos.
images.limitsPt: Figura de sumario sem cotas e sem numeracao de pecas; usar as pranchas especificas para geometria.

images.usePt: Montagem da pedaleira: corta-fogo, vedacao, suporte, mola sobre-centro, bucha, pino, pedal, retentor, cilindro mestre, sensor G476, presilha, mangueira e batente.
images.limitsPt: Vista explodida sem cotas e sem codigos de peca; posicao no veiculo nao dada em XYZ. Forma da mola e do batente exige foto real antes de modelar.

images.usePt: Variante do suporte da pedaleira com amortecimento indicado por setas.
images.limitsPt: Depende do equipamento do veiculo; aplicacao na referencia atual nao confirmada. Sem cotas.

images.usePt: Circuito de volante a esquerda: reservatorio, mangueira de alimentacao, cilindro mestre no corta-fogo, linha ate o cilindro escravo no cambio, retentor na carroceria, sangrador, capa e suporte.
images.limitsPt: Trajeto esquematico sem cotas, sem coordenadas e sem codigos; a peca alongada sobre a linha nao foi identificada por texto. Nao inferir comprimentos nem raios de curva pela figura.

images.usePt: Tres configuracoes da conexao da linha: ranhura circunferencial, ressalto, e ressalto com ranhura.
images.limitsPt: Define onde ha vedacao, nao os diametros. Alocacao das vedacoes depende do catalogo de pecas.

images.usePt: Mangueira de alimentacao de plastico e posicao das vedacoes internas.
images.limitsPt: Variante a partir de 12.05; qual variante vale para a referencia atual ainda nao foi definida. Sem cotas.

images.usePt: Vista de servico do cilindro escravo montado: parafusos do escravo em setas B e apoio do cambio em setas A.
images.limitsPt: Vista parcial de procedimento, sem cotas. O torque do escravo e remissivo nessa pagina; 20 Nm mais 90 graus pertence ao apoio do cambio.

images.usePt: Retirada do cilindro mestre do suporte, com espacador A entre pedal e batente e barra de travamento B.
images.limitsPt: O espacador de cerca de 40 mm e ferramenta de servico, NAO e curso do pedal nem dimensao da peca.

images.usePt: Foto real da guia do rolamento aplicada a este veiculo; confirma flange com 3 furos de fixacao, vedacao vulcanizada e estrias internas.
images.limitsPt: Foto de catalogo sem escala nem cotas. Marcada com OE-Nummer pruefen, ou seja, existem variantes; nao tratar como unica peca possivel.

images.usePt: Segunda vista da guia, em perspectiva, mostrando os tres olhais distribuidos na flange e o corpo cilindrico.
images.limitsPt: Sem escala. Espacamento angular dos olhais so pode ser estimado da foto, nao medido.

images.usePt: Foto real do cilindro escravo aplicado a este veiculo.
images.limitsPt: Foto de catalogo sem escala nem cotas; o OE cobre uma familia longa de sufixos, nao um unico numero.

images.usePt: Vista em perspectiva do escravo: corpo plastico, duas orelhas de fixacao com buchas metalicas, fole sobre a haste e porta de entrada angulada com presilha.
images.limitsPt: Sem escala e sem cotas. A forma justifica substituir o cilindro liso atual, mas nao autoriza medir proporcoes pela foto.

images.usePt: Foto real do cilindro mestre com sensor integrado: haste com ponta esferica, flange com vedacao, conector branco da mangueira de alimentacao e modulo do sensor.
images.limitsPt: Sem escala e sem cotas. O modulo do sensor corresponde ao G476 do manual, mas a foto nao prova a variante instalada no carro de referencia.

images.usePt: Segunda vista do cilindro mestre, outro angulo do corpo e do conector.
images.limitsPt: Sem escala e sem cotas.

userDirection20260910.continuity: Continue accumulated assembly in substantial batches; examples express fidelity, not a request to restart or reorder all work. priorityQueue below is historical dimensional research, not the current implementation sequence.
userDirection20260910.bodyPriority: Latest user direction after seats/door trim: exterior is still very far from a Golf V. Exterior identity takes priority over further interior work. Review real five-door Golf V references against front/side/rear model views, then correct proportions and silhouette before finer details. Preserve already-functional doors/windows/hood/prop/hatch/lights; do not restart hinges. Functional tests are not visual approval.
userDirection20260910.limits: Examples are non-exhaustive acceptance targets, not implemented features. Verify actual Golf architecture before asserting wiring, modules or factory dimensions.
userDirection20260910.currentIntegration: Hydraulic brake bench, accelerator/ECU/throttle, shared thermal cooling, front wiper stalk/controller/four-bar mechanism and fuel float/resistive sender/voltage/filtered instrument. All are didactic models; remaining examples stay long-term requirements.

modelingDelivery.guideApplication: unresolved; three-hole candidate does not prove two-hole model incorrect
modelingDelivery.clutchPackApplication: generic estimated geometry; no OE kit selected, no dual-mass flywheel internals, no pressure or torque simulation
modelingDelivery.auxiliaryLimits: Estimated geometry and routing; cooling and washer command superseded by later deliveries below. No AC/refrigerant, washer fluid or mount dynamics.
modelingDelivery.gearboxLimits: static generic diagram; no OE ratios or tooth profiles, reverse, engagement or torque simulation
modelingDelivery.wheelBrakeLimits: generic estimated geometry; no brake PR selected, no friction, wear or pressure simulation; existing illustrative wheel rotation retained
modelingDelivery.hydraulicBrakeLimits: Supersedes earlier no-pressure wheelBrakeLimits for brakes only. Generic estimated parameters and diagonal layout, PR unverified. No fluid-volume/tandem/vacuum solver, ABS/EBD, wheel slip, load transfer, temperature, wear or parking brake. Bench is not coupled to engine/drivetrain; old illustrative rotation preserved outside bench.
modelingDelivery.egasLimits: Generic estimated voltage curves, fallback and response. No verified VW pinout, current/resistance solver, actual servo/motor mechanics, ECU torque strategy or vehicle acceleration. Manual mode affects throttle and illustrative MAP, not preset RPM; explicit mixture comparison preserved.
modelingDelivery.coolingLimits: Generic estimated thermal calibration and geometry. No VW pressure/boiling/level/leak/cavitation, CFD, real pump drive, sensor-fault circuit, fan controller stages, post-key or AC demand. Internal routes schematic, expansion/degassing static. No overheat torque reduction or damage. Airflow independent of drivetrain; visual rotor/valve motion illustrative.
modelingDelivery.wiperLimits: Estimated dimensions, speeds, controller logic and windshield plane. Not VW pinout/modules/CAN-LIN or verified architecture. No current/torque/stall/thermal model, rain, water jets/level, curved-glass contact, rear wiper or hood interlocks. Repair ideally recouples linkage; afterwash counts two park crossings, first may finish a partial cycle.
modelingDelivery.fuelSenderLimits: Generic estimated 280..40ohm, 5V/220ohm, 0.8s filter, reserve12/15percent and fail-safe-empty behavior, NOT VW calibration/pinout or verified controller architecture. Existing generic twin-lobe tank is not a verified FWD volume map. No calibrated litres, slosh/tilt/buoyancy, real sender count or cluster reproduction. Stuck float remains electrically plausible; sender faults do not stop fuel pump.
modelingDelivery.bodyIdentityLimits: Photo-guided estimated procedural shape, still angular/simplified; not factory CAD or fidelity certified. User visual dissatisfaction remains unresolved. Local proportions, lens fit, hatch details and bumper transitions need refinement. CabinFrame hidden only in solid, not structurally remodeled. Existing wiper mechanics retained, no verified glass contact. Rear wiper static. Earlier nonfunctional-lights and unarticulated-doors limits superseded by bodyFunctionalDelivery.
modelingDelivery.bodyFunctionalLimits: Estimated procedural geometry and functional controller, not VW modules, pinout, CAN/LIN or complete factory wiring. Current estimates only; no resistance/network solver. Manual hood support idealized before prop, no gravity/load or collision solver. No anti-pinch, child lock, alarm or actual actuator kinetics. Headlight photometry illustrative. Visual Golf identity and moving-detail fit still need work. No drivetrain engagement/torque completion.
modelingDelivery.bodyFitLimits: Estimated geometry, not OE dimensions or final Golf identity. Rear lenses share skin profile and hinge but no seal/contact solver. Hood split preserves outer datums and existing hinge, not factory bonnet measurements. Overall silhouette, bumper/cabin transitions and low-resolution seam aliasing still need refinement.
modelingDelivery.interiorTrimLimits: Estimated geometry without new factory dimensions or photo comparison. No seat adjustment/folding, upholstery deformation or audio. Existing seat mounts, structure, pedals and wiring preserved; some wiring/structure under dashboard and cowl mechanism remain exposed. Pocket ray measures120mm from probe above opening to bottom, not verified useful depth. Next headliner/pillar and lower dashboard finish. Not complete Golf/factory interior.
modelingDelivery.cockpitLimits: Estimated geometry without new photo comparison or factory measurements. Generic RPM/coolant dials, not VW cluster/calibration/network; no fictitious speedometer. Steering, horn, radio, climate controls, glovebox, gear lever and parking brake are not newly functional. Existing pedals/wipers/fuel remain shared. Some structure/wiring and cowl mechanism remain exposed. Next suggested seats, inner door trim and floor finish while preserving mechanisms; Golf identity not certified.
modelingDelivery.bodyCabinLimits: Estimated contours and28mm perimeter returns, not factory stamped doors or watertight solids. Wheel and hinge datums retained; fixed quarter glass remains separate. Vertical clipped-pane motion unchanged, no regulator/tracks/anti-pinch/contact or collision model. Screenshots reviewed without new photo comparison; Golf fidelity incomplete. Next suggested visible interior/dashboard/steering-wheel refinement with existing controls, not a new mechanical implementation from scratch.
modelingDelivery.bodyFrontLimits: Estimated procedural shape and clearances, not factory geometry. Grilles/fog pockets are fitted dark inlays, not cut-through openings or airflow ducts. Reflectors illustrative, no physical optics. Corner setback up to160mm, unchanged wheel/door/hinge datums. New front screenshots reviewed without new photo comparison; Golf identity still incomplete, next cabin/pillars/side apertures. Existing bodyFunctionalLimits retained.
modelingDelivery.bodyProportionLimits: Visual estimates, no factory measurements or new photo comparison. BodyProfile isolates shared geometry from engine physics. Hatch opens -1.5rad with central lower edge above1800mm estimated. Rigid wiper links preserved; no curved-glass contact or panel collision simulation. Front optics/grille/nose still simplified, Golf identity not approved. Earlier preserved-hinge and unchanged-door-boundary descriptions refer to previous deliveries.
modelingDelivery.bodySurfaceLimits: Estimated surface refinement only. Visual review still shows long-looking hood, angular cabin and simplified front transitions/lens fit; Golf V identity remains unresolved. Door boundaries and panel junctions preserved. Existing wiper contact has not been recalculated for bowed glass. No factory dimensional claims.

researchHandoff.agentBriefPt: Pesquisar somente o item escolhido da fila, sem editar a aplicacao. Entregar fotos reais ou desenhos identificados, URL da pagina e da imagem, codigo da peca, aplicacao e restricoes, cotas documentadas e lacunas. Salvar imagens localmente e atualizar este indice usando o padrao existente. Nao refazer pesquisas concluidas, nao assumir 4Motion, nao usar imagem simbolica para geometria, nao pagar servicos nem enviar arquivos a terceiros. Sem cotas suficientes, relatar a lacuna e encerrar a busca do item.
